LESSON: READING FOR FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.5 Reading for Fluency (2 lessons) • Word recognition • Fluency (rhythm
Topic 2.7: Reading for Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading for Fluency, part of Reading 2.5 Reading for Fluency (2 lessons) • Word recognition • Fluency (rhythm in Grade 8 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How does fluency enhance communication? 34 ● take turns to read sentences about feelings and emotions from charts (e.g. 你今天感 觉怎么样?我感觉难过。和朋友玩的时 候感觉怎么样?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read aloud words and phrases on feelings and emotions from flashcards in turns (e.g. 开心 kāixīn、高兴 gāoxìng、难过 nánguò、惊讶 jīngyà、愤怒 fènnù、紧 张 jǐnzhāng、快乐 kuàilè、生病 shēngbìng、怕 pà、不好意思 bù hǎo yìsi、兴奋 xīngfèn, etc.),

2. collaboratively match the activity with the appropriate feelings, emotions or needs associated with it (e.g. 和朋友玩- 开心 Hé péngyǒu wán - kāixīn ),

3. sort flashcards depicting various feelings and emotions into ‘happy feelings/emotions’ and ‘sad feelings/emotions’ with peers,

4. read word cards and simulate/express the feelings and emotions depicted collaboratively (我饿了、我困了、我吃 饱了、我渴了),

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read aloud words and phrases on feelings and emotions from flashcards in turns (e.g. 开心 kāixīn、高兴 gāoxìng、难过 nánguò、惊讶 jīngyà、愤怒 fènnù、紧 张 jǐnzhāng、快乐 kuàilè、生病 shēngbìng、怕 pà、不好意思 bù hǎo yìsi、兴奋 xīngfèn, etc.),
2. collaboratively match the activity with the appropriate feelings, emotions or needs associated with it (e.g. 和朋友玩- 开心 Hé péngyǒu wán - kāixīn ),
3. sort flashcards depicting various feelings and emotions into ‘happy feelings/emotions’ and ‘sad feelings/emotions’ with peers,
4. read word cards and simulate/express the feelings and emotions depicted collaboratively (我饿了、我困了、我吃 饱了、我渴了),

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading for Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: teamwork skills are exhibited as the learner participates actively in simulating

the feeling/emotion depicted in flashcards with peers.

• Self-efficacy is developed as the learner discusses practical solutions for how they can deal with their emotions with peers.

Values:
Love is nurtured as the learner interacts with varied emotions from peers during simulation exercises, developing a sense of

understanding and awareness.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Mental health: the learner develops the ability to regulate their emotions effectively as they research and propose practical

approaches for managing their emotions with peers.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the concept of managing one's feelings and emotions appropriately to Religious Education.
